[[Kitta]] can be found with [[Gareth]], [[Latham]], [[Hroth]], and several [[Festive Norn]] all drunk and enjoying themselves outside of the [[dungeon]] of [[Frostmaw's Burrows]].

She joins [[Latham]] on his quest to avenge his brothers by slaying [[Frostmaw the Kinslayer]].
